title: Best of China and Japan: Great Wall to Mount Fuji
alt: Chureito pagoda with Mount Fuji behind it
transport: Group tour with private transfers, fast trains and guided touring

stops.name: Beijing
stops.subtitle: Beijing → Mutianyu
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Central hotel a short walk from Wangfujing

activities.name: Great Wall at Mutianyu
activities.match: Mutianyu Great Wall of China Tickets
activities.description: Tickets for the Mutianyu section, the steepest and least crowded of the restored stretches, reached by cable car from the valley.

activities.name: Temple of Heaven
activities.description: The round sacrificial halls and long raised walkway where Ming and Qing emperors prayed each year for a good harvest.

activities.name: Tai chi lesson with a foot rub
activities.match: Tai Chi Class with Foot Massage
activities.description: A short guided tai chi session in the park, followed by a traditional Chinese foot massage to settle the legs after the wall.

activities.name: Beijing city tour
activities.description: A guided day across Tiananmen Square and the Imperial Palace, with the Capital Museum and the performing arts centre.

activities.name: Hutong tricycle tour
activities.description: A ride by cycle rickshaw through the grey brick hutong lanes, the old courtyard housing that survives behind the main roads.

program.name: Beijing
program.description: Three nights in the capital with the wall at Mutianyu, the Temple of Heaven, the Imperial Palace and the hutong lanes.

stops.name: Nanjing
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Central hotel close to the Xinjiekou shops

activities.name: Nanjing sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided afternoon on Purple Mountain with the Sun Yat sen mausoleum and the pine groves around Linggu temple.

program.name: Nanjing
program.description: One night in the old southern capital, with Purple Mountain, the Sun Yat sen mausoleum and Linggu temple.

stops.name: Shanghai
stops.subtitle: Shanghai → Suzhou and Tongli
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Riverside hotel in Pudong with skyline views

activities.name: Suzhou sightseeing
activities.description: The Humble Administrator's Garden, the largest of the classical Suzhou gardens, and the old shopfronts along Pingjiang road.

activities.name: Boat ride on Tongli lake
activities.description: A slow boat across the water at Tongli, a canal town of stone bridges and whitewashed houses an hour from Shanghai.

activities.name: Shanghai city tour
activities.description: A guided day along the Bund waterfront and across to Pudong, with the restored lanes of Xintiandi and Tianzifang.

program.name: Shanghai
program.description: Two nights on the river, reached through the gardens of Suzhou and the canals of Tongli.

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Large hotel beside Shinagawa station on the main rail lines

activities.name: Tokyo sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day with Sensoji temple and the Nakamise stalls, Meiji Jingu, the Shibuya crossing and the sumo arena at Ryogoku.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Two nights in the Japanese capital, with a full guided day and a free evening in the Shinjuku lanes.

stops.name: Kawaguchiko
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Lakeside resort with Mount Fuji across the water

activities.name: Arakurayama Sengen Park
activities.description: The hillside park above Fujiyoshida where the Chureito pagoda frames Mount Fuji, the view on most Japan postcards.

activities.name: Boat ride on Lake Kawaguchi
activities.description: A short sailing on the lake with the mountain reflected in the water on a clear day and the wooded shoreline behind.

activities.name: Mount Fuji fifth station
activities.description: The highest point reachable without climbing, at the tree line on the north face, with the crater rim above you.

program.name: Kawaguchiko
program.description: One night under Mount Fuji, with the pagoda viewpoint, a lake sailing and the fifth station on the mountain.

stops.name: Kyoto
stops.subtitle: Kyoto → Shiraito Falls and Nagakute
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Comfortable hotel facing Kyoto station

activities.name: Iyashi no Sato Nenba village
activities.description: A rebuilt village of thatched farmhouses under Mount Fuji, with craft workshops and an old water mill still turning.

activities.name: Shiraito Falls
activities.description: A wide curtain of spring water falling from a rock face in threads, fed by snowmelt running off the slopes of Mount Fuji.

activities.name: Toyota Automobile Museum
activities.description: Three floors of restored cars tracing the motor car from early European models through to the Japanese production years.

activities.name: Kyoto sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day with the gold pavilion at Kinkakuji, the torii rows at Fushimi Inari, Tenryuji temple and the Gion lanes.

program.name: Kyoto
program.description: Two nights in the old imperial city, reached through the thatched village at Nenba and the Shiraito falls.

stops.name: Osaka
stops.subtitle: Osaka → Nara
stops.hotel: Holiday Inn Express Osaka City Centre - Midosuji, an IHG Hotel
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Modern hotel on Midosuji close to the Namba lanes

activities.name: Nara sightseeing tour
activities.description: Todaiji with its great bronze buddha and the old timber halls of Horyuji, among the oldest wooden buildings standing anywhere.

program.name: Osaka
program.description: One night in Osaka after a guided stop at Nara, with the Hozenji lanes a short walk from the hotel.

stops.name: Okayama
stops.subtitle: Okayama → Himeji
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Station hotel a short walk from Korakuen

activities.name: Himeji Castle
activities.description: The white keep above the town, the finest surviving Japanese castle and the only major one never destroyed by fire or war.

activities.name: Korakuen gardens
activities.description: One of the three great gardens of Japan, laid out beside the river with wide lawns, tea houses and a borrowed castle view.

activities.name: Kibitsu Jinja
activities.description: A hillside shrine with a roofed corridor running almost four hundred metres down the slope between cedar trees.

program.name: Okayama
program.description: One night in Okayama with the white keep at Himeji, the Korakuen gardens and the long corridor at Kibitsu Jinja.

stops.name: Hiroshima
stops.subtitle: Hiroshima → Kurashiki and Miyajima
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · City hotel a short walk from Peace Memorial Park

activities.name: Hiroshima sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided walk through Peace Memorial Park, the museum and the Atomic Bomb Dome left standing as it was in 1945.

activities.name: Itsukushima shrine
activities.description: The vermilion gate standing in the shallows off Miyajima island, one of the most photographed structures in Japan.

program.name: Hiroshima
program.description: A final night in Hiroshima, reached through the canal quarter at Kurashiki, with Peace Memorial Park and the floating gate.

expert.name: Mei
expert.quote: Two countries in one run, with the Great Wall at the start and Mount Fuji in the middle. Nobody comes back wanting more.
expert.tip: Pack light for the Japan half. From Tokyo onwards you change hotel most nights and the group moves by train.

summary: Fifteen days across China and Japan on a group tour: the Great Wall and the hutongs of Beijing, Nanjing and Suzhou, the Bund in Shanghai, then Tokyo, Mount Fuji, Kyoto, Nara, Himeji and Hiroshima.
included: Included: 14 nights with daily breakfast across nine cities; travel insurance; private transfers and fast trains; Mutianyu Great Wall tickets; Temple of Heaven; a tai chi lesson with a foot rub; the Beijing city tour and a hutong tricycle ride; Nanjing sightseeing; Suzhou sightseeing and a Tongli lake boat ride; Shanghai city tour; Tokyo sightseeing; Arakurayama Sengen park; a Lake Kawaguchi boat ride; Mount Fuji fifth station; Iyashi no Sato Nenba; Shiraito falls; the Toyota Automobile Museum; Kyoto sightseeing; Nara sightseeing; Himeji castle; Korakuen gardens; Kibitsu Jinja; Hiroshima sightseeing; Itsukushima shrine.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the Shanghai to Tokyo internal flight; China and Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; personal expenses.
